name_ar: فرز النهج الوكيلي وتصميم الأدوات وتحصين التقييم
name_en: Agentic approach triage, tool design and eval hardening
what: يقرر هل تحتاج المهمة وكيلًا أصلًا، ويختار البنية والأدوات، ثم يقيّمه ويحصّنه بتسجيل المسار وسقوف الحلقات وواجهات أدوات وCLI صديقة للوكلاء. — Decide whether a task needs an agent at all, pick topology and tools, then evaluate and harden it with trajectory scoring, loop caps and agent-friendly tool or CLI interfaces.
when: Designing a new agent or LLM feature, asking agent-vs-workflow or single-vs-multi-agent, an agent is unreliable, slow or expensive, or building a CLI that agents call.
how: 1) Walk the decision tree: agent-vs-workflow gate -> single vs multi-agent -> orchestration topology -> framework. 2) Design tools: unambiguous names, typed parameters, examples inside descriptions, errors that teach recovery, a small tool count. 3) Plan context and memory strategy. 4) Build an offline eval over a fixed task set scoring task completion, trajectory and tool-use correctness (golden datasets, LLM-judge). 5) Harden loops: step and tool-call caps, retries, guardrails. 6) For agent-facing CLIs follow compact, predictable output conventions.
params: task description; candidate frameworks; eval dataset; step cap

name_ar: حلقة وكيل محدودة بإنجاز يتحقق منه الجهاز
name_en: Bounded agent loop with machine-verified completion
what: يحوّل هدفًا محددًا إلى خطة مهام قابلة للتحقق وينفذها مهمة مهمة مع فحوص يشغّلها المتحكم وإعادة محاولة بسقف وتصعيد بشري، ولا يُغلق قبل التحقق من كل مهمة أو الإعفاء منها. — Compile a concrete goal into a verifiable task plan, run it task by task with controller-run checks, capped retries and human escalation, and refuse to close until every task is verified or waived.
when: User wants an agent or subagent to drive a goal to done unattended, tighten a definition of done because agents claim completion early, or run a long goal as resumable fresh-context iterations.
how: 1) Ask forcing questions first: observable DONE outcome (artifact plus a command that exits 0), no-touch paths, escalation owner, budget (default 12 loop iterations, 3 attempts per task). 2) Compile goal to plan JSON (vague goals are refused). 3) Init state file; loop `next` -> execute one task -> `record` -> `verify`, where the controller itself runs the check command and stores evidence. 4) Never adjudicate your own verification or edit the gate; a retry must change approach. 5) Exhausted budgets escalate (exit 2/5), never fake success; only a human waives. 6) Close is refused while anything is unverified; durable state lets a fresh session resume.
params: goal text; domain manifest; max_attempts_per_task; max_loop_iterations; no-touch paths

what: يحدد سقفا للمحاولات لكل هدف وعند بلوغه يتوقف ويقدم الحالة وفرضيات مرتبة. — Cap attempts per objective and, at the bound, stop and report state with ranked hypotheses instead of trying again.

name_ar: حفظ تصحيحات الجلسة في ذاكرة دائمة عبر الجلسات
name_en: Capture session corrections into persistent memory
what: التقاط التصحيحات والدروس الدائمة أثناء الجلسة ثم تخزينها وإعادة تحميلها (تحديث CLAUDE.md أو ملفات ذاكرة محلية أو خدمة ذاكرة مستضافة) لتبدأ الجلسات اللاحقة بسياق جاهز. — Capture corrections and durable insights during a session, then store and reload them (CLAUDE.md updates through a reflect step, local memory files, or a hosted memory service) so later sessions start informed.
when: User says 'remember this', corrects the same thing twice, a session starts or resumes after compaction, or project knowledge must outlive the chat.
how: 1) Detect learning signals in-session (explicit corrections, repeated preferences, decisions). 2) Queue them and remind the user to run a reflect step rather than silently rewriting instructions. 3) On approval write durable items to CLAUDE.md or a project memory directory, one fact per entry, dated. 4) At session start or resume, load or search stored memory (local files, or a hosted librarian when a key is configured). 5) Sync incrementally from the last checkpoint so repeated runs are cheap. 6) Periodically classify entries as delete, merge, shorten or keep, and back up before pruning. Procedure inferred from descriptions, not from the scripts.
params: storage target (CLAUDE.md|memory dir|hosted service); approval mode; checkpoint scope

name_ar: تنفيذ الخطط بوكلاء مسمّين وسجل تقدم دائم
name_en: Execute plans with named agents and progress ledger
what: تنفيذ خطة مكتوبة بالعمل المباشر افتراضياً واستدعاء وكلاء مسمّين معرّفين مسبقاً فقط في موجات متوازية بعد فحص السلامة، مع سجل تقدم مرتبط بـgit يسمح بالاستئناف بعد الضغط. — Run a written plan by implementing directly by default and spawning only predefined named agents in safety-checked parallel waves, while a git-backed progress ledger lets the work resume after compaction.
when: Large plan with independent tasks; fan-out of two or more independent jobs; resuming an interrupted plan; deciding whether delegation is worth it; requests to parallelize or orchestrate.
how: 1) Load the plan, map task dependencies, list the unblocked tasks. 2) Before any spawn answer four questions: why can't I do it myself, which named agent fits, is it independent enough, what exactly do I pass. 3) Use only predefined agents (explorer, researcher, planner, coder); never fake a subagent by injecting a prompt at call time. 4) Group unblocked tasks that clear a safety checklist (no shared files, no dependencies) into one wave and dispatch it in a single message. 5) Read results and integrate; you own coherence. 6) Append '- [x] Task N: name - commits base..head, review clean' to a ledger file per feature; after compaction trust ledger plus git log over recollection.
params: plan file path; agent roster; wave size; ledger path (.condux/progress/<slug>.md style)

name_ar: توضيح الرسائل المعقدة قرارًا قرارًا
name_en: One-decision-at-a-time clarification of dense messages
what: يعيد صياغة رسالة كثيفة أو مجموعة أسئلة بحيث يُعرض قرار واحد في كل مرة مع تعريف المصطلحات وإجابة مقترحة وتحديد ما يجب على القارئ حسمه. — Rewrite a dense, decision-heavy message or question set as one decision at a time with defined jargon, a recommended answer and the exact thing the reader must decide.

name_ar: مراسلة مباشرة بين جلسات Claude Code العاملة
name_en: Peer messaging between running Claude Code sessions
what: استشارة جلسة Claude Code تعمل بالفعل أو تفويضها باستخدام ListAgents وSendMessage مع العنونة الصحيحة وأشكال الاستدعاء ومعالجة الردود وإظهار الحركة للإنسان، بدل claude -p أو قراءة الطرفية. — Consult or delegate to an already-running Claude Code session with ListAgents and SendMessage using correct addressing, call shapes, reply handling and human-visible traffic, instead of headless claude -p or terminal scraping.
when: You need a fact, answer or unit of work from an open session; a delegated agent has gone silent; waiting without polling; Claude and Codex agents must talk as peers; a human wants to see who is asking whom.
how: 1) Check the Claude Code version supports native messaging (>=2.1.224). 2) ListAgents; the name shown is the address; send the bare name and add [ref] only to disambiguate, never a stale ref. 3) Pick a shape: quick question (peer answers with its own SendMessage), work order (ask to be notified when idle, then read the result), conference (multi-turn; reply using the sender attribute of the inbound wrapper). 4) Cloud peers receive but cannot reply, so read their transcript. 5) Never invent a peer's answer if it refuses. 6) Name sessions consistently across ListAgents, Remote Control and tab title; log a message envelope for visibility. 7) Codex lacks these tools; bridge via panes.
params: peer name; call shape (question|work order|conference); notify-when-idle flag

name_ar: شجرة قرار حدود المراحل والتسليم بين الجلسات
name_en: Phase-boundary tree: continue, clear, handoff, delegate, compact
what: المرور على شجرة قرار مرتبة من خمسة فروع عند نهاية كل مرحلة لاختيار المتابعة أو المسح أو التسليم أو التفويض أو الضغط، وكتابة ملف تسليم يشير إلى المواصفات والخطط والقرارات بمسارها لا بنسخها. — Walk an ordered five-branch decision tree at each finished phase to choose between continuing, clearing, handing off, delegating or compacting, and write handoff files that point to specs, plans, ADRs, issues and diffs by path or URL instead of copying them.
when: Context window filling up; unsure whether to clear or compact; moving work to another harness, directory, worktree or colleague; a /handoff request; resuming from a continuity file; caching hard-won research before it is lost.
how: 1) Gate: only at a real phase boundary (last output settled, next phase not started); mid-phase just continue or push remaining work to a subagent. 2) Walk top-down, first match wins: CONTINUE if the next phase needs current context and the window is still in its quality zone; CLEAR only if everything is positively confirmed disposable; HANDOFF only if you can name what crosses which boundary (harness, directory, person, parallel fork); DELEGATE if the rest is bounded enough to run unattended; else COMPACT. 3) Handoff file: present tense, agent-facing, resumable, references by path or URL, never inline copies. 4) Check links resolve and run a secret scan before it leaves the machine.
params: boundary type (harness|directory|person|fork); target agent; where to store the handoff file

when: A crash, pause or blocked run needs continuing, or checkboxes may have drifted from reality.

what: توقف عن التعديل بعد المحاولة الثانية الفاشلة لنفس الأسلوب وأعد التتبع من منشأ الخطأ. — Stop editing after the second failed attempt of the same approach and re-trace from the source of the fault.
when: Catching yourself re-running with tweaked values; user says going in circles.
